features-v2-dark.svg: WHO GETS IN: Organisations, roles and entitlements, owned here. Zitadel v4 does the login: OIDC, passkeys, MFA. WHAT THEY PAID FOR: Stripe events become one entitlements table. The paywall reads that table. WHO ASKS: Studio, widgets and SDK apps call this service. It answers with identity events on the NATS bus

lead-v2-dark.svg: synthwerk-identity owns organisations, roles, entitlements and the paywall for the synthwerk services. Zitadel says who you are. This service decides what that is worth.

what-v2-dark.svg: Owns the model: Owns organisations, roles and entitlements for every synthwerk service. Login by Zitadel v4: OIDC, passkeys, MFA. No login form lives here. Stripe in, entitlements out: Turns Stripe events into one entitlements table. The paywall reads that table. Identity events: Emits identity events on the NATS bus. The other services trust them

startnotes-v2-dark.svg: Go on main: main holds the Go service: orgs, members, roles and the Zitadel user hook. Needs Postgres: SYNTHWERK_IDENTITY_DATABASE_URL is required.
